note: Knowledge chunks for the ingestion scan (review round 5, N-038). found: the wordings the red team used and the planted demo injection; the scan is developed against these. held_out: other wordings, written before the scan was changed and never used to tune it. benign: ordinary policy text that shares words with the attacks; it must not be held back. visibility defaults to public. Do not add patterns from held_out or benign; to measure a new idea, write new cases.
